title: Verisys wallet 50k
classTag: A EMI §12 / §14.II · A live photo / TAT
why: Digital wallet opens on NADRA Verisys plus screening. Monthly load is PKR 50,000. This is e-money, not a bank deposit.
trigger: Taps Open wallet. Eligible digital ID. Verisys and TFS clear.
alternate: Duplicate CNIC, OTP fail, sanctions, NADRA outage (UJ-E05–E11).

nodes.label: Open wallet
nodes.customer: Opens app or web and taps Open wallet.
nodes.system: Creates application. Channel, device hash, IP, geo if permitted. Not a bank CIF.

nodes.label: Tracking ID on screen
nodes.customer: Sees Tracking ID. Can copy it. No SMS yet.
nodes.system: Issues Tracking ID in-app only. No destination until OTP.

nodes.label: Mobile OTP · 2FA
nodes.system: 2FA required (EMI §12). Does not skip state on wrong OTP.

nodes.label: SMS Tracking ID
nodes.customer: Receives SMS: wallet application started + Tracking ID.
nodes.system: First out-of-band notify only after OTP success.

nodes.label: Consents and fees
nodes.customer: Accepts T&Cs, privacy, NADRA/BV, fee schedule. Marketing off by default.
nodes.system: Versioned consents. Blocks continue until mandatory accepted.

nodes.label: Identity + Table-A
nodes.customer: CNIC/NICOP/POC/POR/ARC. Two extra non-CNIC fields. Live CNIC image.
nodes.system: EMI §12 minimum + Consolidated Table-A. CNIC uniqueness check.

nodes.label: Live photo
nodes.customer: Centers face. Captures live photo. Good light, no mask.
nodes.system: Encrypted upload. Face match vs ID. Liveness is not NADRA BV.

nodes.label: Sanctions / PEP
nodes.customer: Sees Under review. Does not see list names.
nodes.system: UNSC + ATA + PEP + watchlist before payment-service use. Fail closed if provider down.

nodes.label: Home + Increase limit
nodes.customer: Balance, pay, IBFT in. Banner to complete biometric for 400k.
nodes.system: Ledger enforces 50k load and 10k/day cash-out. Trust posting at par when funded.

title: NADRA BV upgrade 400k
why: Biometric verification raises commercial monthly load to PKR 400,000 (pilot: 200,000). Selfie is not BV.
trigger: Taps Increase limit on a VERISYS wallet.
success: limit_tier=BV. Banner shows new monthly load. Cash-out from CRP.
alternate: BV fail → UJ-E07. NADRA down → UJ-E08.

nodes.label: Increase limit
nodes.customer: Taps Increase my limit. Told SBP 50k vs 400k.

nodes.label: How to do BV
nodes.customer: In-app fingerprint/face, NADRA e-Sahulat, or partner ATM.

nodes.label: In-app BVS
nodes.system: NADRA BV adapter. No raw template store.

nodes.label: e-Sahulat / ATM
nodes.customer: Completes BV at NADRA agent or partner ATM (no card if offered).
nodes.system: Receipt/ATM adapter. Confirm BV not CNIC-only Verisys.

nodes.label: NADRA BV success
nodes.system: 400k commercial or 200k pilot. Cash-out from CRP.

nodes.label: BV fails
nodes.customer: Retry, e-Sahulat, or video KYC. Wallet stays 50k.
nodes.system: Do not fake BV. Stay VERISYS.

title: Enhanced wallet 1M
why: After commercial licence, PSP&OD may allow up to PKR 1,000,000 if SoF, CNIC-SIM pairing, TMS, and CRP are done in-house.
trigger: BV wallet. EMI has enhanced product approval. Customer requests.
alternate: Missing SoF or pairing → remain BV.

nodes.label: CNIC–SIM pairing
nodes.customer: Confirms mobile ownership on this device.
nodes.system: Pairs CNIC to SIM/device of the instrument.

nodes.label: TMS + CRP
nodes.system: Robust TMS scenarios + detailed risk profile. In-house.

nodes.label: PSP&OD path already live
nodes.system: Product already approved; this is per-customer control check.

title: One credit then unverified close + STR
why: EMI may allow one credit before credentials are verified. If verification fails, close the instrument and file STR. Recommended default is off.
trigger: Product flag allows one inbound before NADRA/screen complete.
success: If later verified → continue UJ-E01. If not → closed + STR.
alternate: Prefer disable this flag and verify first.

nodes.label: One inbound
nodes.system: Ledger allows exactly one. No spend if policy stricter.

nodes.label: Close + STR
nodes.customer: Wallet closed. Support copy without extra PII.

title: Duplicate CNIC — one wallet
persona: Yasmin — already has this EMI wallet
why: A CNIC holder may open only one e-money instrument with this EMI. Copy must say You already have a wallet — not a vague reject.
trigger: CNIC hash matches an open wallet at this EMI.
alternate: Closed wallet reopen policy — Legal.

nodes.label: Clear message
nodes.customer: You already have a wallet — log in.
nodes.system: Redirect intent. Not Rejected by policy only.

title: OTP / 2FA fail
why: Wrong OTP never skips CONTACT_VERIFIED. After N fails, cool-down. Change number is a new attempt.
trigger: Wrong OTP, expiry, or different mobile.
success: Mobile verified → CONTACT_VERIFIED. Then SMS Tracking ID.
alternate: Cool-down. Support via in-app Tracking ID.

nodes.label: Enter mobile
nodes.customer: Types mobile. Helper: PTA-registered in own name.

nodes.label: Enter OTP
nodes.system: No OTP in logs. 2FA confirm or fail.

nodes.label: Change number
nodes.customer: Optional new number. New attempt rules.

title: BV fail → stay 50k / video KYC
why: Greenfield EMI has no branches. Do not pretend BV succeeded. Keep Verisys 50k or use Verisys+MSISDN or recorded video KYC + Verisys.
trigger: Live photo OK. BV fails for an eligible reason.
success: Stay VERISYS 50k, or video+Verisys then BV upgrade later.
alternate: No-show → reschedule. No debit-block bank product.

nodes.label: BV eligible fail
nodes.system: Eligible-reason check. Do not mark BV.

nodes.label: We’ll verify another way
nodes.customer: Plain EN/UR. Wallet can stay at 50k.

nodes.label: Path
nodes.customer: Keep 50k, try e-Sahulat, or book video KYC.

nodes.label: Stay VERISYS 50k
nodes.customer: Explicit 50k banner. Increase limit still available.

nodes.label: Video KYC + Verisys
nodes.system: Retain recording. Verisys. EMI without presence path.

nodes.label: Assured
nodes.system: Still not BV unless NADRA BV succeeds.

title: NADRA timeout / outage
why: NADRA 503 never becomes silent 400k or silent activate. Hold IN_PROGRESS. Resume ≤ 30 days.
trigger: NADRA timeout or 503.
alternate: Max retries → video/case. Still no silent upgrade.

nodes.label: NADRA call fails
nodes.customer: Verification taking longer + Tracking ID. No fake Wallet ready.

nodes.label: Hold — no STP
nodes.customer: Retry CTA. Can leave and come back.

title: Tracking ID + TAT 2 WD
why: Tracking ID on screen from Step 0. SMS after OTP. Individual decision TAT 2 working days. No silent stall.
trigger: Any in-flight or delayed wallet application.
alternate: Unknown ID → generic error. Entity TAT 5 WD is UJ-E17.

nodes.label: Where the ID is
nodes.customer: On-screen from Step 0. SMS after OTP. Email if captured.

nodes.label: Next step shown
nodes.customer: Progress, limit tier, next action. No extra PII.

title: Sanctions / fraud true match
why: Confirmed UNSC/ATA hit or fraud lock is fail-closed. No e-money instrument. No STP retry.
trigger: Confirmed sanctions/proscribed hit after adjudication, or fraud lock.
alternate: Potential hit first → Under review until adjudication.

nodes.label: Sanctions screen
nodes.system: UNSC + ATA + watchlist. Fail closed if provider down.

nodes.label: True match / fraud
nodes.system: No instrument. Audit. No STP retry.

title: PEP / high-risk EDD + video
classTag: A EDD · A recorded video NFTF
why: High CRP or PEP needs extra SoW/SoF and recorded video. Customer waits. Senior approval is ops-side.
trigger: PEP yes / list hit, or CRP HIGH.
success: Wallet with enhanced monitoring, or written decline.
alternate: Missed interview → reschedule. Delay → UJ-E09.

nodes.label: Extra verification needed
nodes.customer: Told additional verification is required. Not 50k STP if policy EDD.

nodes.label: Recorded interview
nodes.system: Recording retained. Senior path if PEP.

nodes.label: Decision
nodes.customer: Approve with monitoring or written reject.

nodes.label: Wallet + monitoring
nodes.customer: Can use wallet. Limit tier per BV/Verisys.

title: Agent cash-in / cash-out
why: Agents cash-in/out and redeem. They must not open wallets. Cash-in and cash redemption need BV. ATM cash-out needs 2FA.
trigger: Existing wallet holder visits SBP-approved agent or ATM.
success: Cash moved at par. Alerts fire.
alternate: Agent tries to issue → blocked.

nodes.label: Cash-in
nodes.system: BV required. Credit e-money at par. Trust posting.

nodes.label: Agent cash-out
nodes.system: BV or 2FA if BVS is a major challenge. Limit engine.

nodes.label: Full cash redemption
nodes.state: WALLET_ACTIVE or closed after full redeem

nodes.label: Agent cannot issue
nodes.customer: Told to open in the app.

title: Minor basic linked wallet
why: Minor wallet opens only from the parent/guardian app, linked, funded only from parent wallet. 50k Verisys. Guardian undertaking. TMS.
trigger: Guardian with active wallet starts Add child wallet.
alternate: Digital Form-B may be out of allow-list — confirm Legal.

nodes.label: Minor identity
nodes.customer: Minor details. Confirm Legal on Form-B vs CNIC family.

nodes.label: Minor 50k Verisys
nodes.customer: Child wallet visible in parent app.
nodes.system: limit_tier=MINOR_BASIC. Fund only from parent. TMS on.

title: Minor freelancer enhanced
why: Freelancer minor may get 400k BV, still linked to parent app. Funding parent or verified income. Not adult 1M enhanced.
trigger: Guardian requests freelancer limits. Minor NADRA BV.
alternate: No BV → stay basic 50k.

nodes.label: Verify income source
nodes.customer: Parent wallet and/or EMI-accepted freelance income evidence.

nodes.label: Freelancer 400k
nodes.customer: Higher minor load. Still not 1M adult enhanced.

title: Inward remittance exclusion
why: After EPD approval via an Authorized Dealer, inward remittance up to PKR 1.5m may be excluded from load caps for BV holders if SBP granted the exclusion. Still CDD/TMS.
trigger: BV wallet. EMI has AD arrangement. Inward PRI/home remittance.
success: Credit posts; may not consume 400k load if exclusion granted.
alternate: No SBP exclusion → counts toward monthly load.

nodes.label: AD + EPD approval
nodes.system: EMI licensed path via Authorized Dealer.

nodes.label: BV holder
nodes.customer: Must already be biometrically verified for exclusion.
nodes.system: Exclusion is for BV wallets except minors.

nodes.label: Remittance in PKR
nodes.system: IBFT/Raast via trust/settlement bank. Cap 1.5m if exclusion.

nodes.label: TMS still on
nodes.system: Exclusion is from load math, not from AML.

title: Salary credit exclusion
why: Salary from employer’s nominated bank may be excluded from load limits for BV holders if SBP granted exclusion. EMI must verify the employer.
trigger: Employer pays to EMI wallet via authorised FI.
success: Salary posts; may sit outside monthly load.
alternate: Unverified employer → counts as normal credit.

nodes.label: BV wallet
nodes.system: Exclusion not for Verisys-only or minors.

nodes.label: Verify employer
nodes.system: EMI verifies employer via nominated bank path.

nodes.label: Salary IBFT
nodes.system: If exclusion granted, omit from load cap.

nodes.label: Not excluded
nodes.system: Employer not verified or no SBP grant.

title: Merchant / entity wallet
classTag: A TAT 5 WD · A one wallet per entity
why: Entity wallets are Phase 2. Table-B / UBO. TAT 5 working days. One wallet per entity with this EMI. Not the individual state machine.
trigger: Business / merchant onboarding.
success: Merchant wallet. UBOs stored if legal person.
alternate: Sanctions on BO → reject. Gaps → more info.

nodes.label: Entity intake
nodes.system: entities table. Not v1 individual SM.

nodes.label: TAT ≤ 5 WD
nodes.customer: Tracking ID. Longer than individual 2 WD.

nodes.label: Merchant wallet
nodes.system: One wallet per entity. UBOs stored.

title: Decline mandatory consents
why: T&Cs, privacy, NADRA/BV, and fees gate issuance. Marketing is optional and off by default.
trigger: Leaves a mandatory box unchecked.
alternate: Save draft (UJ-E19).

title: Abandon and resume ≤ 30 days
why: Draft saved up to 30 days. Return to last incomplete step. Day 31+ expired; new application.
trigger: Exits mid-flow.
alternate: Day 31 → EXPIRED. New Tracking ID.

nodes.label: Draft ≤ 30 days
nodes.customer: Tracking ID already on screen from Step 0.

nodes.label: Last incomplete step
nodes.customer: Lands on live photo, not the start.

nodes.label: Day 31+ expired
nodes.customer: Application expired — start a new one.

title: Periodic / event KYC refresh
why: Scheduler marks REFRESH_DUE. Overdue restriction is explicit. Re-screen. BV may be re-required for high assurance.
trigger: Calendar interval or ID expiry / adverse event.
alternate: Ignore → explicit restrict. CTA back to refresh.

nodes.label: REFRESH_DUE
nodes.customer: Not yet restricted if inside grace.

nodes.label: Review profile / ID
nodes.customer: Confirms fields. Uploads if asked. May re-BV.

nodes.label: Re-screen + CRP
nodes.system: Fresh TFS/PEP + risk. Material change → EDD.

nodes.label: Overdue restriction
nodes.customer: Explicit restrict copy — not a silent clamp.
